tasks.objective: Recover the real persistent host state read-only without resetting or mutating the queue.
tasks.deliverable: Host snapshot containing DB integrity, queue/running/failed/blocked/stale counts, leases, process state, provider state, CPU/RAM/disk observations and checkpoint identifiers.
tasks.evidence: Timestamped command log plus database/checkpoint identity and raw counts.
tasks.verification: Independent recount from the same DB/checkpoint.
tasks.success: Counters are measured and internally consistent.
tasks.failure: Host inaccessible, DB corrupt, or counts inconsistent; preserve state and mark BLOCKED.

tasks.objective: Complete manuscript provenance without changing frozen science.
tasks.deliverable: Claim-to-table/figure-to-processed-to-raw-to-config-to-commit provenance map and final evidence-generated tables/figures.
tasks.evidence: Artifact IDs/hashes and source refs for every quantitative manuscript claim.
tasks.success: Every quantitative claim traces to retained evidence.
tasks.failure: Any untraceable claim is removed or explicitly flagged.

tasks.objective: Perform novelty, experimental and mechanism reviewer attacks.
tasks.deliverable: Three-reviewer matrix with severity, required evidence and cheapest decisive response.
tasks.evidence: Criticisms tied to manuscript and retained artifacts/literature audit.
tasks.success: No acceptance-threatening unsupported claim remains unresolved.
tasks.failure: Paper stays not-ready with explicit blocker.

tasks.objective: Freeze same-provider learned direct-generation baseline and OOD protocol.
tasks.deliverable: Immutable preregistration covering provider/model, prompt families, typed-IR/direct arms, validity/execution/semantic metrics, cost accounting, seed/repetition policy and falsifier.
tasks.evidence: Protocol committed before any new result.
tasks.failure: Do not execute an ambiguous or post-hoc protocol.

tasks.deliverable: Raw generations, parser/validator/STL outputs, per-case metrics, aggregate uncertainty and compute/cost table.
tasks.evidence: Source commit, provider/model, prompt-set hash and raw outputs.
tasks.success: Typed-IR advantage survives the predefined gates.
tasks.failure: Preserve negative result and demote; no prompt/metric rescue.

tasks.objective: Close confirmed source-level profile-role escalation boundary on an isolated branch.
tasks.deliverable: Migration/policy hardening plus regression checks; no production-applied claim.
tasks.evidence: Exact SQL/code diff and available test/CI output.
tasks.verification: Policy review against normal-member escalation and allowed self-profile update.
tasks.success: Source policy prevents direct privileged-role writes without breaking intended profile edits.
tasks.failure: Keep product security-blocked and record exact unresolved path.

tasks.objective: Resolve exact production revision and health boundary.
tasks.deliverable: Served immutable SHA/deployment ID plus health/readiness and incident evidence.
tasks.verification: Compare served SHA with verified source commit/descendant.
tasks.success: Exact intended verified source is proven live.

tasks.objective: Freeze and execute one real multilingual-encoder leakage audit.
tasks.deliverable: Preregistered protocol, negative controls, raw probe outputs and verifier result.
tasks.evidence: Model/data versions, split/hash, probe controls and per-seed rows.
tasks.success: Effect survives realistic controls under frozen gate.
tasks.failure: Close as negative transfer; no probe retuning.

tasks.objective: Run a matched learned-operator baseline and OOD physical-regime attack after a scientific slot opens.
tasks.deliverable: Matched-budget learned operator comparison with misaligned/OOD regimes and raw per-seed field/metric outputs.
tasks.evidence: Config, parameters/compute, dataset/regime hash and raw metrics.
tasks.success: Bounded mechanism remains competitive under frozen gate.
tasks.failure: Restrict/close scientific claim if learned baseline dominates.

tasks.objective: Resolve immutable deployment/hydration identity before seven-role certification.
tasks.deliverable: Served commit/build marker, hydration/browser evidence and seven-role checklist results.
tasks.evidence: Deployment ID, browser artifacts and non-secret authorization denials.
tasks.success: Exact source is live, hydration is clean and role boundaries pass.
tasks.failure: Remain externally blocked with exact failing journey.
